title: Balogh–Clemen–Lidický conjecture on the balanced bipartite distance of $K_4$-free graphs
statement:
Let $G$ be a $K_4$-free graph on $n$ vertices. The **Balogh–Clemen–Lidický conjecture.** $G$ can be made balanced bipartite by removing at most

$$
\frac{n^2}{9}
$$

edges.
This conjecture asks whether the sharp bipartite-distance bound for $K_4$-free graphs matches the bound suggested by the complete tripartite graph. The surrounding text identifies it as a conjecture of Balogh, Clemen, and Lidický; no resolution is given here.
source_name: József Balogh, Ignacy Buczek, Andrzej Grzesik and Piotr Kuc, “Balanced bipartite distance of K_4-free graphs”, arXiv:2605.05346 (2026).
references:
**2 papers in this index state this conjecture** (2024–2026). The statement above is taken from the most recent of them; the others are [arXiv:2412.13485](https://arxiv.org/abs/2412.13485).

Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.05346

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of May 2026).
